items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: The interviewee discusses Willie's father (Professor Umpham) and describes the father's house, but the interviewer is the one who explicitly states 'we know them very well' regarding Willie. The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship with Willie.

ctx.x: Yeah. Professor Umpham. From Valence and Liberty uptown. Yeah. That's where that is. Yes.

That was how. I know some of his, I know his son Willie the clarinetist and the- Yeah, Willie Umpham, he got one. And the grandchildren. Yeah. Percy and the young Willie, we know them very well. Ah. But we know them. But I never knew the old man Jim.

He lived on that side, that big white school up there, the valent school in that house and you could go in his house and you had an instrument and an old iron in his house. All around. Teach it to every an instrument you want. That's what he could do.
